Dear Mr. Ranawat,

Greetings!

Through this mail I am sharing my plight of making a big blunder to purchase a sofa-cum-bed and a centre table from your company. Allow me please to give a chronological detail of the awful experience-

-
**31 March 2025:** I ordered 1. an Ayaana Sheesham Wood 3-seater Sofa Cum Bed with Cane Weaving (Teak Finish), 2. Two Vedic 1-seater Sofa with Cane and Brush detailing (Teak Finish) and 3. A Waldo Centre Table (Honey Finish) vide Order ID 881896.
-
**3 May 2025:** All items were delivered at my residence. The Centre Table had a big crack on a corner.
-
**5 May 2025:** I lodged a complaint** **about the defective table and also shared a photograph. After a prolonged and extremely difficult persuasion over many phone calls and mails , your team agreed to arrange a reverse pick up and replace the table.
-
In the meantime, I tried the sofa cum bed and realised that the sliding channels are defective and the bed cannot be unfolded.
-
**17 May 2025:** I lodged a complaint regarding the defective sofa-cum-bed along with a video. The customer care guys agreed to pick up the set and rectify the same.
-
**22 May 2025:** The centre table was replaced and the sofa-cum-bed was picked up for rectification.
-
Despite my persistent follow ups, the sofa-set is not delivered back to me till date.
-
At least for last 15 days, the customer care guys are promising to deliver the sofa in 3-4 days.
-
Today, on our follow up, the customer care guys called back and told that the channels to be replaced and could not be procured yet, and again promised that it will be delivered within 3-4 days.

After getting the delivery of the furniture, to make space for the same, I have disposed my old sofa set. During last two months, my family is facing tremendous inconvenience without the sofa and also shame and embarrassment as we can't offer a seat to our guests.



I have lost all hope and confidence on your company. I am also sick and tried with the follow ups and false promises. The entire episode has left me dismayed and unnecessarily stressed which I need to end immediately.

**In this circumstance, I request you either to resolve the issue by end of today or  take the items back and refund my money so that I can arrange another set of furniture. If the issue not resolved in the stated manner, I would be compelled to seek legal recourses. As I don't have the email IDs of the other co-owners and, your customer care guys refused to share the email IDs, I am sharing this message with Mr. Lokendra Singh Ranawat through LinkedIn and on your social media pages to draw their attention too. **

Regards,

Soumitra Ghosh

comments.body:
Greetings!
Through this mail I am sharing my plight of making a big blunder to purchase a sofa-cum-bed and a centre table from your company. Allow me please to give a chronological detail of the awful experience-
31 March 2025: I ordered 1. an Ayaana Sheesham Wood 3-seater Sofa Cum Bed with Cane Weaving (Teak Finish), 2. Two Vedic 1-seater Sofa with Cane and Brush detailing (Teak Finish) and 3. A Waldo Centre Table (Honey Finish) vide Order ID 881896.
3 May 2025: All items were delivered at my residence. The Centre Table had a big crack on a corner.
5 May 2025: I lodged a complaint about the defective table and also shared a photograph. After a prolonged and extremely difficult persuasion over many phone calls and mails , your team agreed to arrange a reverse pick up and replace the table.
In the meantime, I tried the sofa cum bed and realised that the sliding channels are defective and the bed cannot be unfolded.
17 May 2025: I lodged a complaint regarding the defective sofa-cum-bed along with a video. The customer care guys agreed to pick up the set and rectify the same.
22 May 2025: The centre table was replaced and the sofa-cum-bed was picked up for rectification.
Despite my persistent follow ups, the sofa-set is not delivered back to me till date.
At least for last 15 days, the customer care guys are promising to deliver the sofa in 3-4 days.
Today, on our follow up, the customer care guys called back and told that the channels to be replaced and could not be procured yet, and again promised that it will be delivered within 3-4 days.
After getting the delivery of the furniture, to make space for the same, I have disposed my old sofa set. During last two months, my family is facing tremendous inconvenience without the sofa and also shame and embarrassment as we can't offer a seat to our guests.
I have lost all hope and confidence on your company. I am also sick and tried with the follow ups and false promises. The entire episode has left me dismayed and unnecessarily stressed which I need to end immediately.
In this circumstance, I request you either to resolve the issue by end of today or take the items back and refund my money so that I can arrange another set of furniture. If the issue not resolved in the stated manner, I would be compelled to seek legal recourses. As I don't have the email IDs of the other co-owners and, your customer care guys refused to share the email IDs, I am sharing on your social media pages to draw their attention too.
Regards,
Soumitra Ghosh

Dear Sir,
In reference to your trailing mail our point by point rebuttal are as under:-



1. Walken Sheesham Wood Bed with Full Drawer Storage (King size, Honey Finish) - The problem is in the drawers. Hence taking drawers back to workshop would result in product being reorganised which implies that originality of the product would be compromised. Hence we request you to replace the drawers with new drawers.



2. Auric Large Bar Cabinet (Honey Finish) - Totally unacceptable as from day one the product was defective and it was brought to the notice of your technician who had conveyed that it would be exchanged with the new piece as it is not repairable.



**3. **Hazeline 3-Drawer Wooden Chest Of Drawers (Honey Finish) - We have no issues if it is remanufactured again and replaced in a manner where it does not compromise on the originality of the product.



Thanks



Anmol Bhargava
